title: ARC Raiders Black Friday 2026: where and when to get 50% off
body:
# ARC Raiders Black Friday 2026: where and when to get 50% off

If you have been putting off your first trip into the Rust Belt, Black Friday 2026 gives you a good reason to gear up.

ARC Raiders is now **50% off** on all major platforms (Epic, Deluxe Edition plus upgrade only). The Deluxe Edition upgrade is also half price on participating storefronts.

Each digital storefront has its own Black Friday window, so check the dates for your platform below to make sure you do not miss out:

* **PlayStation 5:** Discount runs **Nov 16 - Nov 30 (Base game only)**. Buy on PlayStation Store

* **Epic Games Store:** Discount runs **Nov 17 - Dec 1 (Deluxe Edition and Deluxe Edition upgrade)**. Buy on Epic Games Store

* **Steam:** Discount runs **Nov 19 - Dec 3 (Base, Deluxe, Upgrade)**. Buy on Steam

* **Xbox Series X|S:** Discount runs **Nov 19 - Dec 3 (Base, Deluxe, Upgrade)**. Buy on Xbox Store

Cross-platform multiplayer works across PC and consoles, and **Live Update 2.7.0** is on the way, so there is no better moment to team up with your squad and head Topside.

See you there!

The ARC Raiders Team
